digo: Chibugu sicho kolo; Chisikolo (short form); Mlangamia

teaser.en: A climber that seems to grow out of nowhere: Digo named it the plant with no stem base, and they were right.
teaser.sw: Mtambaaji unaoonekana kuota bila chanzo: Wadigo waliuita mmea usio na kitako cha shina, na walikuwa sahihi.
teaser.dg: Mbugu inayoonekana kumera bila kula phatu phosi: Adigo anaiiha mmea usio na kolo, na ni kpweli.

summary.en: *Chibugu sicho kolo* is a mistletoe, growing on the branches of other trees with no roots in the ground. Its name says exactly that: 'climber without a stem base'.
summary.sw: *Chibugu sicho kolo* ni kidusia (mistletoe), kinachoota juu ya matawi ya miti mingine bila mizizi ardhini. Jina lake linasema hivyo hasa: 'mtambaaji usio na kitako cha shina'.
summary.dg: *Chibugu sicho kolo* ni *mistletoe*, mmea unaomera dzulu ya panda za mihi yanjina, bila mizi tsini ya tsi. Dzinare rinagomba hivyo hivyo: 'mbugu dide isiyo na kolo'.

about.en: *Plicosepalus curviflorus* is a woody mistletoe. It grows on the branches of host trees, especially acacias, and taps into them for water and minerals while making its own food with its green leaves. It has thick, grey-green, rather fleshy leaves and clusters of long, curved, tubular red-and-orange flowers that sunbirds visit and pollinate. Its berries are spread by birds, which wipe the sticky seeds onto branches where new plants start. Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: *Plicosepalus curviflorus* ni kidusia chenye miti. Huota juu ya matawi ya miti mwenyeji, hasa migunga, na hufyonza maji na madini kutoka kwayo huku kikijitengenezea chakula chake kwa majani yake ya kijani. Kina majani manene, ya kijani-kijivu na yenye nyama kiasi, na vishada vya maua marefu, yaliyopinda, yenye umbo la mrija, mekundu na ya machungwa, ambayo hutembelewa na kuchavushwa na chozi (sunbirds). Matunda yake husambazwa na ndege, ambao hupangusa mbegu zinazonata kwenye matawi, na hapo mimea mipya huanza kuota. Wadigo hukitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Plicosepalus curviflorus* ni *mistletoe* yenye nyama za muhi. Inamera dzulu ya panda za mihi, hasa *acacia*, na inafyondza madzi na madini kula kpwa mihi hiyo, ela piya inadzihendera chakurya kpwa makodzage ga chijani. Makodzage ganayonona, ga rangi ya chijani na ivu, na gana madzi chidide. Maruwage ni mare, ganayofyuka, dza mabomba madide, ga kundu na ga rangi ya chungbwa, ganamera kpwa mafungu; vitsozi nkugakpwedzera na kugaterya kuhenda tembe. Matundage nkuenezwa ni ndege, ambao nkuphangusa tembe zinazonyata dzulu ya panda, phapho mimea miphya inaphoandza kumera. Adigo anaimanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows on trees in dry bushland and wooded grassland, from north-east Africa and Arabia south through Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota juu ya miti katika vichaka vikavu na nyika zenye miti, kuanzia kaskazini-mashariki mwa Afrika na Uarabuni kuelekea kusini hadi Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Inamera dzulu ya mihi, kpwenye vitsaka vya tsi kavu na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi, kula kazikazini na mlairo wa dzuwa wa Afrika na Uarabuni, kutsupa Kenya na Tanzania kuelekea kusini.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is believed to grow without a stem base or any roots. That is a sharp observation: a mistletoe really does have no root in the soil, because it grows straight out of its host's branch.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba mmea huu unaaminika kuota bila kitako cha shina wala mizizi yoyote. Huo ni uchunguzi makini: kidusia kwa kweli hakina mzizi ardhini, kwa sababu huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye tawi la mti mwenyeji.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala atu anaamini mmea huno unamera bila kolo wala mizi. Hiri ni dzambo ririroonwa sawa-sawa: *mistletoe* kpwa kpweli taina muzi tsini ya tsi, kpwa sababu inamera kula kpwenye panda ya muhi unaoimera dzuluye.

names.en: *Chibugu sicho kolo* means 'climber without a stem base': *chibugu*, small climber, and *kolo*, the base of a stem. *Chisikolo*, 'no stem', is a shortened form, and Pakia gives it as an example of a Digo name whose origin speakers can easily explain. Pakia also records a third name, *mlangamia*, without a meaning. In his naming notes he writes the species as *Plicosepalus parviflorus*. Digo use a separate name, *mnazi wa tsozi*, for parasitic plants in general.
names.sw: *Chibugu sicho kolo* maana yake ni 'mtambaaji usio na kitako cha shina': *chibugu*, mtambaaji mdogo, na *kolo*, kitako cha shina. *Chisikolo*, 'bila shina', ni umbo fupi, na Pakia analitoa kama mfano wa jina la Kidigo ambalo wazungumzaji wanaweza kueleza asili yake kwa urahisi. Pakia pia ameandika jina la tatu, *mlangamia*, bila maana yake. Katika maelezo yake kuhusu majina anaiandika spishi hii kama *Plicosepalus parviflorus*. Wadigo hutumia jina tofauti, *mnazi wa tsozi*, kwa mimea vimelea kwa ujumla.
names.dg: *Chibugu sicho kolo* rina mana ya 'mbugu isiyo na kolo': *chibugu*, mbugu dide, na *kolo*, photsi ya muhi. *Chisikolo*, 'chisicho na kolo', ni dzina rifupi ra hiro, na Pakia anarihumira dza mfwano wa dzina ra Chidigo ambaro atu anaogomba Chidigo anaweza kueleza upesi kula ririphotuluka. Pakia piya anaandika dzina ra hahu, *mlangamia*, bila kulavya manage. Kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina, anaandika aina hino kukala ni *Plicosepalus parviflorus*. Adigo anahumira dzina ranjina, *mnazi wa tsozi*, kpwa mimea yosi inayoishi kpwa kufyondza mihi yanjina.

reason.en: Another mistletoe; Digo label for parasitic plants
reason.sw: Kidusia kingine; jina la Kidigo la mimea vimelea
reason.dg: *Mistletoe* yanjina; dzina ra Chidigo ra mimea yosi inayofyondza mihi yanjina

reason.en: Epiphyte that also lives on trees
reason.sw: Mmea unaoishi juu ya mimea mingine (epiphyte), nao huishi juu ya miti
reason.dg: Mmea unaosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, nawo piya unaishi dzulu ya mihi

reason.en: An acacia, a typical mistletoe host
reason.sw: Mgunga, mwenyeji wa kawaida wa kidusia
reason.dg: *Chigundi*, *acacia*, muhi ambao mara nyinji *mistletoe* inamera dzuluye
